newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Six die, several hurt in Philippine bus collision.
newsitem.headline: Six die, several hurt in Philippine bus collision.

text.p: Six people were killed and several injured when two passenger buses collided head-on along a narrow road in the southern tip of the main Luzon island, police said on Friday.
The accident occurred on Thursday around midnight at the boundary of Camarines Norte and Quezon provinces, southeast of Manila.
One of the injured passengers told local police the Manila-bound bus was negotiating a sharp curve when an oncoming bus rammed into it.
Injured passengers from the two buses were taken to nearby hospitals. A local radio station said over 70 people were injured but police said they did not have the exact number of casualties.
